title: Specialty Analyst
description: Role Overview: Volcafe has an opportunity for a strong Specialty Analyst to join its team in Addis Ababa. The role of the Specialty Analyst is to support the Volcafe team in sourcing Ethiopian specialty coffees from growers and exporters across the coffee growing regions of the country, with significant contribution expected in promoting these coffees to clients worldwide. The Specialty Analyst is a key member of the commercial team in Addis, with responsibility to ensure a smooth relationship with suppliers and clients on quality, pricing and delivery of specialty and premium qualities. The role will involve significant travel upcountry, requires consistent communication with various teams at destination. Experience in a modern coffee lab is required. The Specialty Analyst will report to the head of the General Manager. Volcafe Ltd is one of the world’s leading international green coffee trading companies, operating in over 20 countries globally. Our expertise spans green coffee procurement and preparation, sustainability, blending, quality control, risk management and export as well as importing and distribution. We supply the world’s major coffee roasters and retail distributors with their green coffee requirements, with significant strategic growth ambitions for the future. We are part of ED&F Man Commodities, a world leading trader of agricultural products including coffee, sugar, molasses and animal feed. Volcafe Ltd is one of the world’s leading international green coffee trading companies, operating in over 20 countries globally. Our expertise spans green coffee procurement and preparation, sustainability, blending, quality control, risk management and export as well as importing and distribution. We supply the world’s major coffee roasters and retail distributors with their green coffee requirements, with significant strategic growth ambitions for the future. We are part of ED&F Man Commodities, a world leading trader of agricultural products including coffee, sugar, molasses and animal feed. Key Accountabilities Identifying and building a working relationship with specialty suppliers. Maintaining a current list of available lots. Working closely with the QC team to generate and share sensory evaluation reports. Organizing training and other events focused on suppliers of high-quality coffees. Leading and contributing to projects and content aimed at serving the specialty community. Overseeing the smooth execution of specialty purchases in close collaboration with the execution team. Being a key resource person for various stakeholders involved in specialty supply chains. Skills and Experience Bachelor’s degree in Agronomy, Plant Science, Computer Science, Business Administration, International Trade, or a related field. 1–3 years of experience in coffee production, processing, specialty sourcing, supply chain coordination, or related Agri-commodity operations. Experience in a dry mill is a plus. Experience in coffee exports, with exposure to the specialty segment. Capacity to perform under pressure in a fast-paced environment. Detail orientation with proven skills in self- and work management. Excellent oral and written communication in both Amharic and English. Able to operate in a modern corporate computing environment, with a background in data management being highly desirable. Knowledge of Ethiopian specialty qualities, preferably with field experience. Advanced computing skills and experience with task automation is considered a plus. Our Values Respect, Integrity, Meritocracy, Client Focus, Entrepreneurship Volcafe shares the values of our parent company, ED&F Man Commodities. Our values define who we are. They are the fundamental beliefs that determine our actions and guide our behaviour. They influence the way we communicate and collaborate, and define the way we engage with our clients, partners, and communities. title: Education Abroad Advisor
description: Apply now Job no: 507009 Work type: Full-Time Location: Hybrid/Flexible Work Arrangement Categories: Drexel University, Global, Interprofessional, and Specialized Programming Job Summary The Education Abroad Advisor is responsible for promoting education abroad programs to students and stakeholders, advising and supporting students before, during, and after their study abroad experience, and administering select Drexel education abroad programs in select regions of the world. Regional responsibility includes France, Belgium, Switzerland, Spain, and Latin America, though ultimately will be based upon the needs of the Education Abroad team. The Education Abroad Advisor also manages and advises faculty and students on non-credit experiences abroad (NCEAs), which include international service learning, research, athletics, and conferences. The advisor provides guidance on the NCEA application process, facilitates group info sessions and pre-departure support. The Education Abroad Advisor is responsible for the annual review of regional responsibility program brochures and initial creation of new brochures in collaboration with the Associate Director. The advisor has additional administrative duties including, but is not limited to the following: Online pre-departure orientation Being the primary liaison with Drexel’s Enrollment Management and Student Success office and taking the lead on various events, including accepted student days, welcome week, etc. Curriculum integration Additional projects to contribute to the operations of the office will be assigned according to office needs Occasional nights and weekends required Domestic and international travel may be required Essential Functions Recruiting and advising students on study abroad programs in assigned regions of the world Advising students and faculty through the non-credit experience abroad approval process Communicating with various education abroad stakeholders including administrative and academic departments across campus as well as foreign contacts Attending relevant university events and making presentations pertaining to their portfolio of education abroad opportunities as well as education abroad in general Developing marketing campaigns, events, and sessions to recruit students Attending various regional and national conferences and represent Drexel Global at various university events Managing and developing content for the outbound pre-departure orientation Managing curriculum integration efforts in assigned academic area Participating in site visits in support of their program portfolio Providing coverage when other staff members are out of the office Other duties as assigned Required Qualifications Minimum of a Bachelor's Degree or the equivalent combination of education and work experience. The role combines practical home and technical services with tutoring and client support, depending on the candidate’s skills and experience. Day-to-day responsibilities may include providing tutoring support to learners in relevant subjects, performing basic electrical maintenance, plumbing, homecare, and cleaning tasks, and assisting with interior and exterior painting. title: Proposal Writer
organization: Nafrobi  Strategy and Project Management consult PLC
description: Company Description Nafrobi Strategy and Project Management Consult PLC is a consulting firm based in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia, focused on delivering strategic advisory and project management services to public, private, and development sector clients. The firm supports organizations in designing, implementing, and evaluating projects that drive sustainable growth and operational excellence. Nafrobi emphasizes evidence-based decision-making, clear communication, and strong stakeholder engagement in all its assignments. Team members collaborate in a professional, learning-oriented environment, with opportunities to contribute to impactful initiatives across diverse sectors. Role Description The Proposal Writer is a full-time hybrid role based in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia, with flexibility to work part of the time from home. This role is responsible for leading the development of high-quality proposals and responses to Requests for Proposals (RFPs) and other fundraising or bidding documents. Day-to-day tasks include analyzing RFP requirements, coordinating inputs from technical and project teams, drafting and editing proposal narratives, and ensuring compliance with client instructions and internal standards. The Proposal Writer will organize proposal timelines, develop outlines, maintain a library of proposal content, and tailor existing materials to specific opportunities. The role also involves collaborating with business development and subject-matter experts, refining technical content into clear, persuasive language, and supporting continuous improvement of proposal processes and templates. Qualifications Candidates should possess strong Proposal Management skills, including planning, coordinating inputs, and overseeing end-to-end proposal development. Candidates should possess Proposal Writing and Technical Writing skills to produce clear, structured, and persuasive proposal narratives and supporting documents. Candidates should possess experience working with RFPs, including interpreting requirements, ensuring compliance, and organizing responses to evaluation criteria. Candidates should possess excellent Communication skills, both written and verbal, to collaborate with diverse teams and present complex information in accessible language. Bachelor’s degree in fields such as Economics , Sociology,Business, Communications, English, Public Administration, or a related discipline; advanced degrees are an advantage. Prior experience in consulting, development projects, or donor-funded programs is beneficial. Strong attention to detail, ability to work under deadlines, and capability to manage multiple proposals simultaneously. Proficiency in common office and collaboration tools (e.g., word processing, spreadsheets, presentation software) and comfort working in a hybrid office/remote arrangement.

title: Sales Promoter
description: Sales Promoter: Ethiopia Do you have a passion for agriculture and enjoy working closely with farmers and rural communities? We are looking for an energetic Sales Promoter to join our Enza Zaden Sales team in Ethiopia and support demand creation, product awareness and last-mile farmer engagement. If you are excited about promoting high-quality vegetable seeds and helping farmers access solutions that support productivity, keep reading! This is why you want to join us as Sales Promoter at Enza Zaden Meaningful work in farming communities: Play an important role in connecting farmers with high-quality vegetable varieties and practical product information at village, market and community level. Hands-on field exposure: Be part of field marketing activities, basic demonstrations and farmer engagement initiatives that bring our seed portfolio closer to growers. Opportunity to build strong relationships: Work directly with farmers, agro-dealers and local stakeholders while supporting the wider sales team with grassroots activation. Make a difference as Sales Promoter at Enza Zaden As a Sales Promoter at Enza Zaden, you will support our field marketing and demand creation activities across sales areas in Ethiopia. You will work closely with Sales Representatives to increase product awareness, support simple demonstrations and promote our seed brands at the last-mile level. In this role you will need to: Promote our products: Create product awareness in villages, markets, agro-dealer shops and community events. Engage farmers: Conduct basic farmer engagement activities and support demo plots to help growers understand product performance and benefits. Strengthen visibility: Ensure product visibility and distribute promotional materials in the relevant sales areas. Share market insights: Capture simple market observations and provide timely weekly activity reports. Support the sales team: Assist Sales Representatives with grassroots activation, farmer follow-up and local promotional activities. What You Bring As a Future Colleague Completed secondary school; an agricultural or sales-related diploma will be an advantage. Comfortable working in rural communities and engaging directly with farmers. Good communication skills in local languages; ability to communicate in English is an advantage. Ability to ride a motorbike, with a valid riding license where required. High energy, reliable, self-motivated and able to follow structured work plans. Passion for agriculture, community work and building strong relationships. Willingness to travel daily within rural sales areas and support weekend or community events during peak seasons when needed.
